items.name: Portfolio Portal with AI Chat
items.description: This website: a bilingual portfolio with an AI assistant that answers questions about my career using RAG over my own résumé, with a prompt-injection guardrail, cost limits and CI/CD. Built with Spec-Driven Development.

items.name: Multi-Agent Merchant Support
items.description: A LangGraph router sends each message to specialized agents: RAG over approved sources, the merchant’s own data via tools, and external APIs, with guardrails, personal-data redaction and observability. When context is insufficient, it admits the limitation instead of making things up.

items.name: Retrieval Quality Evaluation
items.description: A command-line tool that measures the search quality of a documentation corpus before publishing it to Azure AI Search: it compares vector and hybrid search (BM25 + RRF) on a golden set, with Recall@k and MRR against a baseline.
